items.title: How Has Vistra Stock's Story Changed?
items.summary: Vistra stock closed at $123.87 on Monday, November 23. At that price, you pay 7.2 times the cash its operations brought in over the past year. The S&P 500 as a whole trades at 14.8 times on the same measure. Anyone paying that price should know which business management now asks them to own.

items.title: Strong Earnings Outlook Keeps NRG Energy Stock In Focus
items.summary: NRG Energy reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$9,466 million and net income of US$561 million, with basic earnings per share from continuing operations of US$2.59. The company reaffirmed full year 2026 earnings guidance and issued 2027 net income expectations. The business continued its share repurchase activity, completing US$977 million of buybacks since late 2025.
